note: Six fixtures proving the harness detects what it claims to. docs/testing-strategy.md section 4. If these do not behave as labelled, every later number is meaningless.

sources.content: Doctor's Office Visits. In-Network: Primary care physician visit: $0 copay. Specialist visit: $10 copay. Out-of-Network: Specialist visit: $20 copay.
Emergency Care. In-Network and Out-of-Network: $115 copay per visit. Copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital within 24 hours.

fixtures.label: known good
fixtures.answer: Your specialist copay is $10 in network [sob-doctor-01].

fixtures.label: uncited
fixtures.answer: Your specialist copay is $10 in network.

fixtures.label: unfaithful
fixtures.answer: Your specialist copay is $75 in network [sob-doctor-01]. Referrals are required before every visit [sob-doctor-01]. There is an annual limit of 12 visits [sob-doctor-01].

fixtures.label: correct refusal
fixtures.answer: I could not find that in the plan documents I searched. Please call Member Services at 1-888-778-1478 (TTY 711).

fixtures.label: partially faithful
fixtures.answer: Emergency care is a $115 copay per visit [sob-emergency-01]. The copay is waived if you are admitted within 24 hours [sob-emergency-01]. Ambulance rides are included at no charge [sob-emergency-01].

fixtures.label: faithful multi-claim
fixtures.answer: Your specialist copay is $10 in network [sob-doctor-01]. Out of network it is $20 [sob-doctor-01]. Your primary care visits are $0 [sob-doctor-01]. Emergency care is $115 per visit [sob-emergency-01].
